title: scoRch.generator: Spatiotemporal Classification of Regional Compound Heatwaves (R package, version 1.0.0)

creators.name: Bouhamad, Fawaz
creators.affiliation: Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, Florida, USA

creators.name: Najibi, Nasser
creators.affiliation: Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, Florida, USA

description:
scoRch.generator is the R implementation of SCORCH (Spatiotemporal Classification of Regional Compound Heatwaves), the method of Bouhamad and Najibi for finding regionally extensive compound heatwaves in gridded daily maximum temperature: local heatwaves at every grid cell, regionally extensive days, DBSCAN clusters of heatwave cells, principal-component ellipses with temperature-weighted centroids, four compound-event types, and power-law and log-Gaussian Cox process models.

This record archives the GitHub release of the package. The study's processed input dataset is a separate Zenodo record (version 1.0.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21717874), and the research record of the study (scripts, catalogs and figures) is the repository compound-heatwave-typologies-SCORCH.
notes: Code is GPL-3.0-or-later. The demonstration dataset (inst/extdata/north_america_tmax.nc, ERA5-derived daily maximum temperature on 1,800 one-degree cells between 25-50 N and 130-58 W, from the ARCO-ERA5 archive) and the shipped CDS sample file is CC BY 4.0 for the authors' processing and contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information 2026 (ERA5); the workflow and typology artwork in man/figures are CC BY 4.0 by the authors.
